author: Mary Ella Hastings - Fort Worth Star-Telegram (TNS)
title: Gov. Abbott: Texas Legislature to hold hearings regarding data centers this week
text:
Gov. Greg Abbott said the Texas Legislature will hold hearings this week to discuss data centers.
Abbott said during a press conference Wednesday afternoon in Fort Worth that those discussions will include the financing of data centers. He said they will be working on eliminating the exemption on sales taxes that data centers have, something that he has been in support of.
